extracted.name: Creamy Fish (with Corn, Carrots and Peas) with Dipping Bread
extracted.description: Great recipe for Creamy Fish (with Corn, Carrots and Peas) with Dipping Bread.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 c soup stock or 1/4 broth cube+1/4c water
1/2 c corn, carrots and peas, pre-cooked
instruction_lines: Sauté garlic in oil until golden, add onions and keep sautéing
Add sliced tomatoes and soup stock (or 1/4 broth cube and water). Cover and let simmer.
Season fish with salt and pepper. Slice as desired.
Arrange fish in pan with the tomatoes. Squeeze 1/4 a lemon around the pan. Cover and let it simmer a few minutes.
Turn fish. Add cream. Cover for a couple minutes.
Add the corn, carrots and peas. Gently move around with a spatula to mix. Cook a couple more minutes and turn off.
Slice baguette or french bread into thin slices and heat in a toaster oven until crisp. You may butter, if desired.
Serve with dipping bread. Or enjoy as a main dish with rice.
